verdict.rationale: Viam documents logic modules for event-driven behavior, such as reacting when a sensor reading crosses a threshold to trigger an alert or actuator, or having a motor respond when a camera detects an object. Inline modules can be written in the browser, and the platform advertises cloud fleet monitoring and alerting. However, these reactions are custom code the user writes and deploys as modules, not a documented declarative rule or trigger system. missing for 10: a first-party declarative rules/trigger engine, documentation of alerting rule configuration, scheduling details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
